Subject: Realtime output stalls during peak window (9:00-9:25 PT)

Hi Naomi —

We're seeing repeated stalls on our live WebSocket streams this morning between 09:05 and 09:25 PT. Client sessions show long periods where tokens stop arriving (5–20s gaps) then a burst of many tokens, or complete 5xx responses. Latency (p90) jumped from ~220ms to ~2.1s. Throughput to our consumers dropped ~40% during the window.

Attached is a short pcap of one failing connection and our service logs for the timeframe (quanta_pcap_20280601.pcap, quanta_service_logs_0905-0930.log).

We rely on low-latency streaming for our live triage use case — this is causing user-visible timeouts. Please advise urgently and let us know if you can open a war room.

Marta

Date: 2028-06-01T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime output stalls during peak window (9:00-9:25 PT)

Naomi / Aditya —

Quick triage notes from infra: we've correlated client request-ids in Marta's pcap to edge logs. We see a pattern where chunked transfer frames are being coalesced and then there's a pause while the keepalive/idle timer on our NLB/proxy resets the connection, causing the observed token gaps. In a subset of cases the fallback to a shorter heartbeat didn't trigger due to a missing header from our upstream.

Hypotheses:
1) NLB idle-timeout (30s) + intermittent upstream GC/driver hiccup leads to silent chunking pauses.
2) Proxy-level backpressure with delayed flush on the HTTP2 -> websocket upgrade path during bursty traffic.

Actionable ask: can Quanta provide a request-id for a session that experienced a ~20s gap? We'll pull exact kernel and proxy traces.

Attaching a short runbook excerpt and we should consider a rapid config change: reduce proxy idle timeout to 10s for the Quanta route and enable aggressive keepalives. Patching will require infra deploy but is low-risk.

-dk
David Kim
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

QuantaHealth (large production customer) is experiencing repeated token stream pauses and increased 5xxs during their morning spike. They have active users and SREs on the line. If this persists they will trigger an incident with their platform leadership and this will impact our renewal conversations later this quarter.

- Platform: enable automatic fallback to non-sse/polling endpoint if pause > 3s for any session (Aditya) — as a controlled mitigation. Estimate: 2 hours to enable feature gate for a single tenant.
- CS/Eng: join a 10:15 PT war room and provide a runbook and expected customer timeline (Vanessa / Jonas).

CC'ing Jonas and Vanessa for exec alignment / SLA credit assessment. Marta — we'll confirm timelines in the 10:15 war room.
